core_meaning.primary_meaning: Nasif is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Just, equitable”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Nasif corresponds to the Arabic form نَصِيف (Arabic root ن ص ف (n-ṣ-f); نَصِيف (Naṣīf)). Its core sense is nasif; just, equitable. Nasif is Arabic نَصِيف (Naṣīf) 'just, equitable', from the root ن ص ف (n-ṣ-f). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave ناسف (a different form); the correct form is نَصِيف. The source gloss 'Gentle, Soft, Sensitive' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as naseef.

persian.name: نصیف
